free_visa_notes: Yemen is not visa-free for any major nationality. Due to the ongoing internal conflict, most Yemeni diplomatic missions (including the Washington DC embassy) have suspended issuance of tourist visas; visas are largely restricted to persons of Yemeni origin, international-organization staff, journalists/media delegates, and diplomats. No reciprocity-based fee schedule could be verified for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, or CAN nationals; no VFS/outsourced visa centre was found for Yemen. A new e-visa portal (yemenevisa.org) exists but does not publish a verifiable fee schedule as of this record's date.
